create_ssl_recipe_config: create a Wav2Vec2SslRecipeConfig instance with default base ls960h training setup values
customize_optimizer_config: customize the AdamW optimizer config with custom learning rate and weight decay
configure_lr_scheduler: configure the polynomial decay LR scheduler with custom warmup steps
set_training_regime: set the training regime with custom num_steps and checkpoint intervals
configure_mixed_precision: configure the trainer mixed precision dtype to float16 or float32
